title: Accessibility EARL findings
description: docs/adr/0012 point 5: the subset of EARL 1.0/JSON-LD pragma actually emits for WCAG findings - one Assertion per finding whose rule correlates to a real axe-core rule id, plus pragma's own level/impact/derived_from/coverage_ref/axtree_ref extensions, the same shape usability.earl.jsonld locked (docs/adr/0011). impact is axe-core's own native severity, carried as secondary provenance alongside the canonical, SARIF-normalized level (docs/adr/0012 point 3). Structural correctness for pragma's own fields, not the full official EARL vocabulary.

axtree_ref.description: Reserved: correlating one finding's component to one specific tree.axtree.json node needs a dedicated correlation pass this ticket doesn't build (the same gap catalog.json's x-region.axtree_ref and usability.earl.jsonld's axtree_ref left reserved).
